sections.heading: What you see
bullets: This page lists warranty-related alerts for assets in your visibility window (up to the To date when you refresh).
Admins and IT Ops see alerts for all relevant assets. Employees only see alerts for assets currently assigned to them.
Use the date range to narrow by warranty end date. Clear resets the range filters; the backend window still follows the To field used when loading.

sections.heading: Actions
bullets: Refresh reloads alerts from the server. Open asset goes to the asset detail page.
Welcome text may appear once for new sessions. Each row shows Expired or Due soon and a clear warranty summary.
